strategies.name: Sequential all-reduce with interleaved scaling
strategies.desc: Performs 8 consecutive all-reduce operations with element-wise scaling/unscaling between each stage, exactly as shown in the reference implementation. 8 all-reduce dispatches total. Represents the baseline: straightforward structure trading many dispatches for simple, readable logic with no optimization attempts.

strategies.name: Fused scale-reduce using tensor views
strategies.desc: Pre-computes all scale and unscale coefficients into lookup tensors, then uses tensor indexing to apply them without explicit loops, fusing scale operations with buffer preparation before each all-reduce. Still 8 all-reduce dispatches but reduces local-op overhead by vectorizing the per-shard scaling operations through broadcasting and eliminating Python loops.

strategies.name: Pipelined reduce-scatter then all-gather
strategies.desc: Decomposes each all-reduce into reduce-scatter followed by all-gather phases to enable pipelining opportunities. Uses 16 collective dispatches (8 RS + 8 AG pairs) but smaller per-operation payloads (1/W of original size for RS). Trades dispatch count for potentially better network utilization through smaller message sizes at world_size=224.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level reduction topology
strategies.desc: Exploits potential node structure by performing intra-node reductions first, then inter-node reductions, repeating for all 8 stages. If fully utilized requires 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage) but leverages faster intra-node bandwidth for most data movement, reducing cross-node traffic volume proportionally.

strategies.name: Batched multi-stage with fused local ops
strategies.desc:
Groups multiple stages together by computing several scale/unscale transformations locally before dispatching the next all-reduce, effectively batching local computation. Uses 8 all-reduce dispatches but maximizes arithmetic intensity per dispatch by fusing up to 2-3 dependent scaling operations into single kernel launches, reducing overall kernel dispatch overhead.
